findings.title: Reject class/discriminator disagreement before reconciliation
findings.detail: Reconciliation dispatches on event.type, whereas rendering dispatches on class. Rf1086CashIssueEvent built from the parsed stiftelse fixture event fields with type=formation and registration_confirmed=False passes readiness and emits N. It therefore bypasses confirmed registration and reconciles formation while reporting new issuance. Validate the public event class/discriminator pair before any dispatch.
findings.reproduction: Construct Rf1086CashIssueEvent(**{f.name: getattr(parsed_formation_event,f.name) for f in dataclasses.fields(parsed_formation_event)}, registration_confirmed=False); replace the parsed formation case events with that event; render_rf1086_preview returns ready with main 17670=N.

findings.title: Do not admit a loss reduction below ordinary AS minimum
findings.spec: #172: registered capital reductions for loss coverage when the facts and treatment are clear; #193: complete readiness
findings.detail: The new happy-path loss-cover fixture reduces NOK 30,000 registered capital to NOK 20,000; readiness reports ready. Positive nominal value alone does not establish the ordinary Norwegian AS support boundary. Block this inconsistent registration assertion or require an explicit supported legal exception; use a legally plausible happy-path fixture. Historical reporting access must not imply supported readiness.
findings.reproduction: render_rf1086_preview(parse_rf1086_case(capital_case("loss_covering_reduction"))).status is ready with closing share capital 20000.

findings.title: Clarify dividend authority following loss cover
findings.spec: #172: Any uncertainty affecting ... legal approval ... is a hard block
findings.detail: Loss cover followed by dividend passes with no creditor-notice or statutory-exception facts. Brønnøysund states a loss reduction without creditor notice prevents dividends for three years. Arithmetic reconciliation cannot establish eligibility; block/clarify the later dividend until supported authoritative facts resolve this restriction.
findings.reproduction: Starting from cash_issue fixture (150 shares, NOK 45000 capital), append April loss reduction of NOK 15000 to nominal 200, then May dividend NOK 15000 at NOK 100/share; set closing capital30000/nominal200. Parsed preview returns ready.
